title: Site patterns
intro: Patterns are opinionated page layouts (magazine, company, portfolio, docs). They layer above your theme identity and can be changed independently.
invalid: This pattern cannot be activated. Check its pattern.json and home template.
cleared: Pattern cleared; the theme’s own templates are used again
clear_failed: Could not clear the active pattern
clear_help: Removes the layout pattern so only the active theme renders the site.
note: Patterns do not change theme colors or fonts. Adjust identity under Themes / Theme settings.
